title: readDisposition survives readAt: null
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 Message.readDisposition: 'Absent when readAt is not set.' chat-server message.rs:792 tests contains_key("readAt"), true for readAt:null, so mark-unread injects readDisposition 'displayed' while helpers.rs:624-627 removes readAt. Guard on non-null readAt; clearing readAt must also clear readDisposition. Adjacent to JMAP-yt1w.4(f). Found by the 1e33ec7 audit (wf_af4656ea-dbb, both refuters upheld). Fix with a failing test quoting the draft; extend chat_client_wire.rs where the client exercises it.
close_reason: Fixed against jmap-chat-spec 1e33ec7; test-first, reviewed, gates green (stable/beta/1.88)
